family: all 12 layers and all fixed 30-subject common-coverage voxels together
statistic: one-sample t of subject Fisher z
null: population mean Fisher-transformed direct model-brain correlation equals zero for the fixed 16 images
randomization: one independent +/-1 sign per subject, shared across all layers and voxels in that draw
assumptions: independent participants and joint subject error vectors symmetric about zero under the null
generalization: participants conditional on these images; no inference to a population of new image sets
bootstrap_intervals: pointwise percentile 95% intervals for spatial correlations, conditional on images
